crossRefs.note: They answered him, “You were altogether born in sins, and do you teach us?” Then they threw him out.
The Pharisees therefore answered them, “You aren’t also led astray, are you?
“Listen to me, you who know righteousness, the people in whose heart is my law. Don’t fear the reproach of men, and…
“Blessed are you when people reproach you, persecute you, and say all kinds of evil against you falsely, for my sake.
Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads,
We toil, working with our own hands. When people curse us, we bless. Being persecuted, we endure.
nor thieves, nor covetous, nor drunkards, nor slanderers, nor extortionists, will inherit God’s Kingdom.
When he was cursed, he didn’t curse back. When he suffered, he didn’t threaten, but committed himself to him who judges…
“Don’t think that I will accuse you to the Father. There is one who accuses you, even Moses, on whom you have set your…
Didn’t Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keeps the law? Why do you seek to kill me?”
Then they secretly induced men to say, “We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses and God.”
Indeed you bear the name of a Jew, rest on the law, glory in God,

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: They insulted him and said, “You are his disciple, but we are disciples of Moses.
translations.bsb: Then they heaped insults on him and said, “You are His disciple; we are disciples of Moses.
translations.kjv: Then they reviled him, and said, Thou art his disciple; but we are Moses' disciples.
